name: codex-naming-studio
description: A Codex naming workbench with event-driven hosted requests, claim-fenced result writeback, and native widget support; no API key required.

interface.shortDescription: Collect naming constraints and let Codex return structured name analysis.
interface.longDescription: Codex Naming Studio supports hosted event-driven requests and a native Codex widget. Requests are atomically committed with a dedicated trigger, claimed with a fenced claimId, processed through bazi and research steps, and written back as ranked Chinese name candidates. A localhost browser workbench remains as a development fallback. No API key required.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Naming Studio workbench for this project.
Handle the pending Naming Studio request and write results back to the GUI.
